**Table 1.** Readiness checks derived from the measures: what each requires, where the logic uses it, and what happens to the measure when it fails. Sources: data requirements generated by fqm-execution from each measure, and the elements the CQL reads beyond them (Supplementary Data).

| Check | Requirement | Used by | If it fails |
|---|---|---|---|
| QI-Core profile declared | meta.profile names the QI-Core profile of the retrieve | Every retrieve (the engine retrieves by declared profile) | Record invisible; no error unless the Patient lacks its profile |
| Code in the measure's value set | A standard code in the role's value set (LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM; encounters: a SNOMED CT type) | Retrieve code filters | Record invisible |
| Drug code at the value set's term level | RxNorm code of a term type the value set lists (generic clinical drug or pack) | Medication value sets (exact code match) | Administration invisible: fewer CMS816 denominator and CMS871 population stays |
| Glucose value comparable in mg/dL | valueQuantity in a UCUM mass-per-volume unit | CMS816: result < 40 (and > 80 after it); CMS871: ≥ 200, > 300, > 600 | Comparison is null: events and hyperglycemic days lost while the stay stays counted |
| Status the measure accepts | Results final, amended or corrected; administrations completed (CMS871 also in progress); diagnoses active or abated | Data-requirement status filters; prevalence period of diagnoses | Record dropped |
| Time element present | Result time; administration start (CMS816) or closed period (CMS871); encounter period; diagnosis onset | Hospitalization windows; 24-hour lookback from a dose | Record falls outside every window |
| Patient reference | subject references the Patient | Patient-level retrieval | Record invisible |
| Encounter links its diabetes diagnoses | Encounter.reasonReference or diagnosis points to the diagnosis | CMS871: Encounter with Existing Diabetes Diagnosis | Stay leaves CMS871 unless it qualifies otherwise (only event-free stays can leave) |
| Administration status confirmed by an eMAR event (MIMIC) | A recorded administration event behind a completed status | CMS816: Hypoglycemic Medication Administration; CMS871: Encounter with Hypoglycemic Medication | Status unverifiable |
| Status agrees with the eMAR event (MIMIC) | Completed only if the dose was given | As above | A not-given dose counts: stays added to CMS816's denominator |
| Stay typed as observation (information) | Encounter type in the Encounter Inpatient value set | Both measures: Qualifying Encounter | Stay outside both measures |
